new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview** At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post\-sales operational liaison between our key customers and Silvus manufacturing organization and internal associated departments. The mission is to manage purchase orders, production schedules, delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s long\-term production roadmap. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion **Job Description** ****Key Responsibilities**** * Customer Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customer post sale, managing day\-to\-day operational needs and escalations. Basic Requirements * A self\-motivated professional who thrives in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities. * Languages: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English and either German or Ukrainian. * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field. * Experience: 5\+ years in a post\-sales, account management, or technical project management role, preferably within the Defense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries. * Analytical Prowess: Ability to analyze complex spreadsheets and production schedules to find discrepancies between demand and supply. * Communication: Demonstrated ability to "translate" between a customer's high\-level business needs and a factory's granular production constraints. * Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. We are seeking a Production Program Manager (Production PLPM) to join our team in Taiwan to lead the sustaining phase of our silicon products. In this role, you will support the product lifecycle from post\-production ramp through End of Life (EOL). You will execute yield optimization, Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), second\-source assembly/test qualifications, and ensuring operational continuity for our global customer base. **Your Impact** * Early Production Engagement: Engage early during the pre\-production ramp phase to influence design for manufacturability and ensure a seamless, well\-documented transition from NPI to the mass production sustaining stage. * Lifecycle Ownership: Supporting the full sustaining lifecycle of silicon products, ensuring stability, cost\-efficiency, and quality from post\-NPI through EOL. * Yield Management: Partner with Test and Product Engineering to participate in silicon yield improvements, root\-cause analysis and closure for yield excursions, and executing defined corrective actions. * ECO Management: Collaborate with the coordination, implementation, and validation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) to ensure product integrity and minimal disruption to the supply chain. * Second Source Qualification: Support the qualification process for second\-source assembly, test, and critical BOM components (e.g., Substrate, memory), ensuring technical parity and supply chain resilience. * Sustaining Engineering: Ensure post\-ramp stabilization and guard\-band optimization. Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to resolve field quality issues, process deviations, and manufacturing bottlenecks. * EOL Planning: Support the EOL process, including last\-time\-buy (LTB) coordination, inventory management, and customer transition planning. * Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular status updates to senior management regarding product health, cost\-reduction initiatives, and supply chain risks. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field; Master's degree preferred. * 5\-7 years of experience in semiconductor production, sustaining engineering, or high\-tech program management. * Proven track record in managing silicon yield improvement, ECO processes, and manufacturing qualifications. * Knowledge of semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) operations and quality/reliability standards. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex technical issues. * Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority. * Experience in managing product transitions and EOL strategies. **Preferred Qualifications** * PMP, Agile, or similar project management certification. * Understanding silicon failure analysis and reliability testing. * Experience with supply chain operations and vendor management. * Black Belt in Six Sigma or equivalent process management is a plus. * Proficiency in program management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira). Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.title: Fab Integrated Production and Supply Chain Planning Manager — Advanced Packaging Technology and Service
new_jobs.jd: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Taiwan, TSMC pioneered the pure\-play foundry business model with an exclusive focus on manufacturing its customers’ products. As of 2024, TSMC serves more than 500 customers and manufactures over 11,000 products for high\-performance computing, smartphones, the Internet of Things (IoT), automotive, and digital consumer electronics. It is the world’s largest provider of logic ICs, with an annual capacity of over 17 million 12\-inch equivalent wafers in 2025\. TSMC operates fabs in Taiwan as well as manufacturing subsidiaries in Washington State, Japan and China, and the Company began construction on a specialty technology fab in Dresden, Germany, in 2024\. In Arizona, TSMC is building three fabs, with the first starting 4nm production in 2025, the second by 2028, and the third by the end of the decade. TSMC Advanced Packaging Technology and Service ( APTS) is rapidly expanding to support the next generation of high\-performance computing, AI, and leading\-edge semiconductor applications. As product architectures become more advanced and customer demand becomes more dynamic, production planning in advanced packaging is no longer a traditional scheduling function. It is an integrated supply chain planning role that connects customer demand, wafer supply, backend capacity, advanced packaging operations, material readiness, engineering constraints, and multi\-site manufacturing execution. As a Manager, Production Planning — APTS, you will play a critical role in building and executing an agile and data\-driven, AI\-enabled planning system to maximize customer fulfillment, capacity utilization, cycle time performance, and operational efficiency across TSMC’s advanced packaging ecosystem. This role is ideal for candidates with experience in semiconductor manufacturing, supply chain planning, advanced packaging, production control, or optimization. You will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders across fab, advanced packaging, engineering, business operations, IT, and customer\-facing teams to develop scalable planning processes and systems for one of the most complex manufacturing environments in the world. **Job Responsibilities** **End\-to\-End Supply Chain Planning** * Own and manage Master Production Schedule (MPS) planning for advanced packaging and backend operations, typically covering a 3–6 month planning horizon to identify supply gaps, bottlenecks, loading risks, and capacity fulfillment actions. * Translate customer demand, product mix, engineering constraints, material readiness, and capacity availability into executable production plans across fab, backend, advanced packaging, subcontractors, material suppliers, and internal planning teams. * Drive scenario planning and what\-if analysis to support decision\-making under demand volatility, capacity constraints, and product mix changes, while ensuring demand fulfillment and delivery commitment. **Production Execution and Operations Performance Management** * Plan and monitor advanced packaging production flows, including capacity allocation, WIP movement, cycle time, output performance, loading balance, and bottleneck management. * Analyze operational performance indicators such as DOI, output, WIP, cycle time, capacity utilization, delivery performance, and supply\-demand gaps to identify risks and improvement opportunities. * Partner with manufacturing, engineering, and business teams to resolve planning constraints, improve production delivery, and support new product introduction, technology ramp\-up, engineering changes, and volume ramp planning. **Customer Fulfillment and Delivery Management** * Build an end\-to\-end view of supply readiness across internally manufactured components, externally sourced components, materials, capacity, and multiple manufacturing sites or routes. * Optimize allocation of demand, capacity, materials, and production loading while balancing customer priorities, business objectives, and operational constraints. * Provide clear demand\-vs.\-supply analysis, delivery risk assessment, and mitigation recommendations to improve customer fulfillment, planning responsiveness, flexibility, and execution discipline. **Data Analytics, AI\-enabled Planning Transformation, and Process Excellence** * Lead planning system enhancement, digital transformation, AI adoption, automation, and process re\-engineering initiatives to support APTS growth, product complexity, and faster demand changes. * Define business requirements and operating mechanisms for planning tools, dashboards, simulation models, integrated data platforms, review processes, and decision frameworks. * Partner with IT, AI teams, business users, and cross\-functional stakeholders to convert planning challenges into scalable digital solutions, applying data analytics, optimization, simulation, or AI / ML concepts to improve forecast accuracy, WIP control, delivery planning, and real\-time visibility. **Lead a Team** * Lead and develop a team of planners responsible for demand\-supply matching, delivery management, and execution monitoring. * Drive planning transformation initiatives and build organizational capabilities in supply chain planning, data analytics, and cross\-functional leadership to improve productivity, responsiveness, and delivery performance. * Partner with senior leaders to support long\-term expansion strategy, business growth, and customer fulfillment. **Job Qualifications** * Master degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, MBA, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or related fields. * 10\+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: (1\) Production planning or end\-to\-end supply chain planning. (2\) high\-tech manufacturing, EMS or Semiconductor manufacturing planning. (3\) Backend / assembly / test / advanced packaging operations. (4\) Material planning or manufacturing operations management. * Strong analytical capability with experience in data\-driven problem solving. * Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across manufacturing, engineering, business, IT, and customer\-facing teams. * Hands\-on experience with Excel and data analysis tools; SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools are preferred. * Experience in planning system implementation, business process re\-engineering, or digital transformation is preferred. new_jobs.jd: 【關於龍馬文創科技】 龍馬文創科技長期投入影音、新媒體與原創 IP，持續將 AI 技術導入內容製作與商業應用。 我們擁有台灣原創兒童 IP《小貓巴克里》，作品曾獲金鐘獎肯定並入圍金馬獎；目前 YouTube 頻道已累積超過 822 萬訂閱，內容持續拓展全球市場。 【職務介紹】 我們正在招募 AI 視覺影音設計師，負責品牌、原創 IP 與行銷所需的 AI 圖像及影音內容。 工作範圍涵蓋概念發想、圖像生成、角色一致性、分鏡與動態製作，以及剪輯後製與成品輸出。這個職位的長期培養方向，包含導演與製作人所需的企劃、整合及專案掌控能力。 【主要工作內容】 • 運用 AI 工具生成 IP 角色、場景、道具及影音素材 • 進行圖像精修、合成、調色與生成瑕疵修補 • 依據角色設定、腳本與分鏡，維持不同場景、鏡位、表情及動作下的角色一致性 • 將文字腳本及簡略分鏡轉化為符合商業使用需求的完整畫面 • 製作品牌短影音、AI 微短劇、IP 動畫及社群行銷影音 • 規劃構圖、鏡頭運動、角色表演及視覺節奏 • 完成剪輯、字幕、音效、調色、特效及後期包裝 • 與品牌、行銷及企劃團隊協作，參與創意、腳本與分鏡討論 • 建立角色素材庫、提示詞、風格範本及可重複使用的 AI 製作流程 • 持續評估並導入合適的新工具 【必要條件】 • 具備 AI 圖像／影音生成及圖像精修經驗 • 熟悉 Midjourney、Stable Diffusion、ComfyUI 或同類 AI 圖像工具之一 • 熟悉專業圖像處理工具 • 具備影片剪輯或動態製作能力 • 熟悉 Premiere Pro、DaVinci Resolve、Final Cut Pro、CapCut 或同類工具 • 理解構圖、分鏡、鏡頭語言與影像敘事 • 能掌握品牌及 IP 角色的視覺一致性 • 能獨立處理 AI 生成瑕疵、製作問題與專案時程 • 具備良好的溝通及團隊協作能力 【加分條件】 • 熟悉 Blender、After Effects 或其他 3D／合成工具 • 具備角色一致性、多鏡頭影音或動畫 IP 製作經驗 • 具備兒童內容、品牌影片、攝影或聲音製作經驗 • 熟悉色彩管理、AI 升頻降噪及商業影音輸出 • 了解素材授權、音樂版權、肖像權及 AI 商用風險 【作品集】 應徵時請提供可正常開啟的作品集連結，建議包含： • AI 圖像生成或精修案例 • 角色或場景一致性作品 • 至少一件完整影音作品 • 各項作品使用的工具及個人負責範圍 請勿提供涉及前公司機密、未公開專案或不具公開權利的內容。 【工作資訊】 工作性質：全職 工作地點：台北市中正區林森南路4號3樓之1，距捷運善導寺站約60公尺 上班時段：日班 需求人數：2人 工作經歷：不拘 學歷要求：專科、大學或碩士 管理責任：無 出差外派：無 待遇：面議，經常性薪資達新台幣40,000元以上 兼職合作：如希望採兼職方式合作，可於應徵時提出，將依可投入時間、合作方式及專案需求個別討論 【福利制度】 • 年終獎金及績效獎金 • 三節及生日禮金 • 婚喪喜慶補助金 • 勞工保險、全民健康保險及勞工退休金 • 員工分紅及認股制度 • 年度休假 • 週休二日 【應徵方式】 請將履歷與作品集寄至： kit.oh@realma.com 郵件主旨： 【應徵 AI 視覺影音設計師】姓名｜全職／兼職 若希望採兼職合作，請一併說明每週可投入時間、合作方式及可開始日期。 已透過 104 投遞者不需重複寄送。
